notes.title: Achievements Are Here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone. We've just introduced achievements for the first time. The full game now includes 51 achievements, while the demo has received 15 achievements.

Both the full game and demo feature achievements ranging in difficulty from easy to challenging. Additionally, players have the option to reset game levels if they wish to attempt any missed achievements. Of course, resetting levels will not remove any achievements already earned.

We've done this because of the great feedback from our players, and it is part of our ongoing effort to refine the game and provide a more balanced and engaging experience for everyone. Good luck!

notes.title: Added Achievements
notes.content:
After some player feedback, achievements have now been added to both the full game (to be released in June) and also for the Demo.

There are a total of 51 achievements for the full game, ranging from easy ones to really hard ones. And for the Demo there are a total of 15 achievements. We hope you like them!

notes.title: Itty Bitty Little Kitties Demo Update v1.10
notes.content: After some feedback we have reduced the countdown for the hint timer from 2 minutes down to 60 seconds. This means you can now use a hint once every 60 seconds when you get stuck.

notes.title: Itty Bitty Little Kitties Demo Released!
notes.content: The demo for [i][b]Itty Bitty Little Kitties[/b][/i] has been approved by [i]Steam[/i] and is now ready to play. Everything went smoothly so we decided to release it early.

notes.title: Itty Bitty Little Kitties Demo is Nearing Release
notes.content: The demo for [i][b]Itty Bitty Little Kitties[/b][/i] is complete and has been submitted to [i]Steam[/i] for review. We've got our fingers crossed and hoping that everything goes smoothly for a release in March.
